profile.headline: Georgia Southern University Undergraduate 🦅| Bachelor of Science in Computer Science ⌨🧪| Software Developer at Ciena 🤓

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Developing real time embedded C/C++/Python software for the new Waveserver Data Center transport product, which may include enhancing existing software, creating new features, and supporting new hardware introduction for rapid time to market following an Agile development process

•Contributing to all stages of software development  requirements analysis, design and prototyping, implementation, testing, and eventually maintenance support

•Troubleshooting hardware and software integration as well as performance issues

•Work with hardware, software, verification and system engineering teams to identify root causes for issues

•Field support, helping investigate and collect information to resolve performance or design issues found in current or previous designs

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Provide technical support after merchandise is purchased.
- Help customers maximize the use of software features.
- Maintain awareness and keep abreast of constantly changing software and hardware systems.
- Find the right software upgrades for customers’ programs and systems.
- Develop and maintain applications and programs.
- Leads, monitors, and supervises a group of employees to achieve goals that contribute to the growth of the team
positions.insights: Skills: Scum · C# · JavaScript · Microsoft SQL Server · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Contribute to the development of data analytics, user workflows, interfaces, and security authentication. 
- Create rapid prototypes and design and implement complex, cutting-edge systems with a focus on collecting, managing, and analyzing large sets of data to extract meaningful knowledge. 
- Work with emerging technologies and data science techniques in support of endeavors to address the critical needs of the Intelligence Community, Department of Defense, and other government agencies. 
- Build advanced algorithms to gain analytic insights from a large range of open source and government data. 
- Develops software solutions by studying information needs, conferring with users, and studying systems flow, data usage, and work processes.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Scum · Java · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · JUnit · Postman · Spring Boot · Jira · PostgreSQL · Docker · Maven · Jenkins

positions.title: Tech Associate
positions.description:
- Develop, document, test, and debug software for applications.
- Design and create databases to fulfill application data requirements.
- Design, create, test, deploy, and maintain SQL scripts and procedures for use by applications.
- Implement changes and updates to software when necessary.
- Assist developers in solving new and existing technical issue
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · C#

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description:
- Document and test new software applications
- Assess and develops new application ideas
- Worked on projects that deliver real solutions for our customers, clients and businesses.
- Opportunity to work on a team software project alongside other team members.
- Developed basic software and technology skills
positions.insights: Skills: Kano · Raspberry Pi · Python (Programming Language) · Leadership
